# Home-return notice fixture

`update_notice.png` is a masked copy of the 2026-08-12 failed trade return-home
frame. Only the update-notice OCR region `(360, 180)-(1560, 900)` is retained;
all remaining pixels are black. It is expected to contain the paired texts
`更新` + `抢先看` and `7天内不再显示` + `前往查看`.

The source recording and diagnostic frame were supplied by the repository
owner for this regression test.
